neubrutalism_ui for Flutter

A Flutter widget kit that carries the “neubrutalism” spelling into cross-platform mobile apps.

infm5/neubrutalism_ui on GitHub

Rights
Link and metadata only. License: unverified. Rights policy

Context

pub.dev describes it as “a set of Neubrutalism-style UI components”. Version 0.1.1 was published on 17 March 2023; version 2.0.2 on 10 November 2023. Publisher: infms.dev.

The repository carries a CC0 1.0 dedication.

Observed

  • An iPhone mock-up of a course app. The search bar, icon buttons, cards, and “Start” button have thick black outlines.
  • Solid black shadows sit below and to the right of cards and buttons, with no blur.
  • Buttons use flat fills: saturated blue for the profile icon, pale pink for “Start” and the filter button.
  • Headings use a heavy condensed sans-serif. Corners are rounded more than on most web examples.

Why it belongs

Evidence that the style and the “neubrutalism” spelling moved into native mobile toolkits by early 2023. The larger radius shows a softer variant.

Borrow

On mobile, keep the shadow offset small (about 3 to 4 px) so that dense lists stay readable.
